Before running the full evaluation, we check that the BGMM and DPMM samplers
converge and that NetC14's loss stabilizes. We simulate one chronology for
each combination of sample size and distribution, holding the interval at 2500
years and the number of clusters at three. For each chronology, we run four
chains of the BGMM and DPMM with different seeds and compute the
rank-normalized split $\hat{R}$ (Vehtari et al 2021) on label-invariant
quantities: the concentration parameter $\alpha$, the density $p(t)$ at each
year on a 100-year grid, and, for the DPMM, the calendar age of each sample.
Values of $\hat{R}$ below 1.01 indicate that the chains agree. To keep the
BGMM chains targeting the same posterior, the number of components is chosen
once per chronology by k-means. We also trace the Kullback-Leibler divergence
of each iteration's density from the mean density over the first 10% of
iterations, following `carbondate::PlotConvergenceData()`, and record NetC14's
loss at each epoch.

```{r}
#| label: function-mixture-diagnostics
#| file: R/mixture-diagnostics.R
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: R/mixture-diagnostics.R
#| eval: false
```

```{r}
#| label: convergence-test
#| cache: true
#| time_it: true
#| output: false
convergence_grid <- expand.grid(
  n_samples = c(50, 250, 1250),
  distribution = c("gaussian", "uniform", "skewed"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

chains <- 1:4

# R-hat for each column of a parameter, e.g., each year of the density
rhat_table <- function(fits, parameter, ...) {
  draws <- lapply(fits, get_draws, parameter = parameter, ...)
  draws <- simplify2array(draws)
  rhats <- apply(draws, 2, rhat)

  data.frame(model = class(fits[[1]])[1], parameter = parameter, rhat = rhats)
}

n_scenarios <- nrow(convergence_grid)

rhat_results <- vector("list", n_scenarios)
kld_results <- vector("list", n_scenarios)
loss_results <- vector("list", n_scenarios)

for (i in seq_len(n_scenarios)) {
  set.seed(STARTREK * 6 + i)

  # scenario
  n_samples <- convergence_grid[["n_samples"]][i]
  distribution <- convergence_grid[["distribution"]][i]
  start <- sample(seq(100, 47000), 1)
  end <- start + 2499
  years <- seq(start, end, by = 25)

  # simulate chronology, draw samples, and calibrate
  chronology <- simulate_chronology(start, end, 3, distribution)
  samples <- sample_dates(chronology, n_samples, intcal20)
  calibrated_dates <- calibrate(samples, intcal20)

  # training
  k <- length(initialize(calibrated_dates, seq(start, end), 1:9))

  bgmm_fits <- lapply(chains, \(.seed) {
    bgmm(calibrated_dates, n_clusters = k, seed = .seed)
  })

  dpmm_fits <- lapply(chains, \(.seed) {
    set.seed(.seed)
    dpmm(samples)
  })

  netc_model <- netc(calibrated_dates)

  # diagnostics
  scenario <- data.frame(
    scenario = i,
    n_samples = n_samples,
    distribution = distribution
  )

  rhats <- rbind(
    rhat_table(bgmm_fits, "alpha"),
    rhat_table(bgmm_fits, "density", years = years),
    rhat_table(dpmm_fits, "alpha"),
    rhat_table(dpmm_fits, "density"),
    rhat_table(dpmm_fits, "ages")
  )

  klds <- rbind(
    cbind(
      model = "BGMM",
      kld_trace(get_draws(bgmm_fits[[1]], "density", years = years))
    ),
    cbind(
      model = "DPMM",
      kld_trace(get_draws(dpmm_fits[[1]], "density"))
    )
  )

  rhat_results[[i]] <- cbind(scenario, rhats)
  kld_results[[i]] <- cbind(scenario, klds)
  loss_results[[i]] <- cbind(scenario, attr(netc_model, "training"))
}

rhat_results <- do.call(rbind, rhat_results)
kld_results <- do.call(rbind, kld_results)
loss_results <- do.call(rbind, loss_results)
```

Maximum $\hat{R}$ by model, parameter, and sample size (grid years where the
density is constant across all draws return `NaN` and are dropped):

```{r}
#| label: convergence-summary
aggregate(rhat ~ model + parameter + n_samples, data = rhat_results, FUN = max)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-convergence
#| code-fold: true
#| output: false
svglite(
  filename = "figures/convergence.svg",
  width = 7.5,
  height = 2.75
)

par(defaults)
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mai = c(0.45, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1))

# R-hat
with(rhat_results, {
  sizes <- sort(unique(n_samples))
  x <- match(n_samples, sizes) + ifelse(model == "BGMM", -0.15, 0.15)

  new_plot(xlim = c(0.5, 3.5), ylim = range(c(1, rhat), na.rm = TRUE))
  x_axis(at = seq_along(sizes), labels = sizes)
  y_axis()
  x_title("Number of Samples")
  y_title("R-hat", line = 2.5)
  main("A. Rank-normalized R-hat")
  add_grid(h = 1.01, nx = NA)

  points(
    jitter(x, amount = 0.08),
    rhat,
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.4,
    col = adjustcolor(theme(model), alpha.f = 0.4)
  )
})

add_legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("BGMM", "DPMM"),
  col = theme("BGMM", "DPMM"),
  text.col = theme("BGMM", "DPMM"),
  pch = 16
)

# KL divergence
new_plot(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = range(kld_results[["kld"]]))
x_axis()
y_axis()
x_title("Proportion of Iterations")
y_title("KL Divergence", line = 2.5)
main("B. Divergence from Initial Density")
add_grid()

for (.s in split(kld_results, ~ model + scenario)) {
  lines(
    .s[["iter"]] / max(.s[["iter"]]),
    .s[["kld"]],
    col = theme(.s[["model"]][1]),
    lwd = 0.6
  )
}

# NetC14 loss
new_plot(xlim = range(loss_results[["epoch"]]), ylim = c(0, 1))
x_axis()
y_axis()
x_title("Epoch")
y_title("Scaled Loss", line = 2.5)
main("C. NetC14 Loss")
add_grid()

for (.s in split(loss_results, ~scenario)) {
  .loss <- .s[["total"]]
  lines(
    .s[["epoch"]],
    (.loss - min(.loss)) / diff(range(.loss)),
    col = theme("NetC14"),
    lwd = 0.6
  )
}

dev.off()
```
